edit.description: `claude_entries` returns `Vec<(HarnessRelativePath, bool)>` — it already spells the form by hand (`to_canonical_spelling(rel)` over a `strip_prefix(root)`), so the change is `HarnessRelativePath::from_path(rel)` and the form enters through its own door. `governed_by_any_path` and `governs` take `&HarnessRelativePath` in place of `&str`, their prose assertions of the form (`governs`'s 'harness-relative `path`') deleted as the type now carries it. The two consumers read through the existing impls: `KNOWN_SURFACES.contains(&&*path)` through `Deref<str>`, the locus match through the same, and `Diagnostic::warn(UNCLAIMED_RULE, &path, ..)` through `AsRef<str>`. `normalize_root`'s directory compare takes `&*path`. The unit tests pass `HarnessRelativePath::new(..)` at their six call sites.

`HarnessRelativePath`'s doc enumerates the form's carriers — ten of them, the census three ticks of entries closed — as the argument that 'a path fact's root is its type, not its doc comment'. The list gains `coverage_note`'s `.claude/` entry pair as its eleventh. Named out of the list and left raw on purpose: the `DriftError` variants whose fields the error text interpolates (`SegmentReapWave::manifest`, `Nondeterministic::path`) assert the form in prose too, but a message payload is formatted once and never joined or compared, so it carries no fact a reader could disagree about — the population the carrier list does not claim, and this entry does not either.

summary: The stray scan's `.claude/` entry paths carry the harness-relative form as bare `String`/`&str`, outside `HarnessRelativePath`'s carrier list.

per.section: A shared concept is one type

tests.asserts: the governance unit tests compile and pass against the typed signature unchanged — the fold is behavior-neutral, so the existing suite (including the whole-locus and directory cases) is the whole proof and no new assertion is owed
the stray findings' `artifact` strings are byte-identical — the type's door canonicalizes a value `to_canonical_spelling` already produced, so no finding's path moves

acceptance: cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --all --check and the rustdoc gate green; `rg 'path: &str' src/coverage_note.rs` is empty, `path.rs`'s carrier list names the stray scan's pair, and no diagnostic path byte moves.
notes: Behavior-neutral by construction and stated as such: the producer already canonicalizes and the one consumer already compares canonically, so this entry buys the form at the type rather than fixing a live defect — the gap is that `path.rs`'s carrier list claims a census the tree does not quite satisfy. Serialized behind the matcher entry: both rewrite `src/coverage_note.rs`, and the typed signature lands on top of the retired leaf test, never beside it. scoped at 3444b912
